cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: I Know How to Win This
cards.instruction: Perform mastery of the rules, odds, and consequences while improvising every decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You moved your marker to ten, so I've moved mine there. Strong opening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I just scored ten points. We haven't started your turn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Checking the scoring range before I commit to a move.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put it back at zero. You only move it after you score.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Zero, then. No point exposing my scoring strategy before my turn.

reason: Replace the unsupported confidence overlay with a concrete misunderstood copied action that directs the same-holder Drive pursuit, with a responsive partner and an ending using B4.
